question: To what kind of person who has been tested over a year must a certain thing be given?
premises: Something is marked as to be given.
That recipient is one who was previously accomplished.
That previously accomplished person has been tested for one year.
inference: What is to be given belongs only to a previously accomplished person who has been tested for one year.
uncertainties: The object to be given is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who was previously accomplished and tested for one year.
